_comment: Apify Actor configuration. Edit Actor IDs to swap providers; the script reads pricing only as a sanity-check and tracks ACTUAL spend from Apify API responses (computeUnits + datasetItems). Pricing fields are estimates as of 2026-05 and will drift — they're for budget planning only.

metadata.comment: Apify's official Instagram scraper. 'details' mode returns view/like/comment count plus owner metadata for a single post.

comments.comment: Pulls top-N comments. Default sort is by most relevant (Instagram's own ranking). Cost scales with results returned.

metadata.comment: Free-tier-friendly TikTok scraper. Returns plays / likes / comment count for a single post.

comments.comment: TikTok comment fetcher. Most Actors don't expose 'sort by likes' — what's returned is roughly top-by-engagement.
